color.note: One set of colours, black and electric blue (page 15 of the design canvas), whatever a device is set to. Colour is a signature: Signal blue is the community and its Signal, mint the studies, each of the twelve agents its own hue; the one main action is electric blue; everything else is black, graphite and near-white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The ground of every page and of Sig's window, under a faint 64px grid and an ultramarine wash at the top (--ink, --paper, --os-win in code).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, plates, fields and the read strip on surface (--card, --surface).

tokens.name: violet-deep
tokens.usage: The violet band's deepest corner, top left: a grainy gradient ground for a few statement bands (How it works' opening, Join, the weekly email), so the black pages aren't flat. Words on it are white; its main action is black (decision, November 16).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: The violet band's middle, where its words sit (white words on it: 4.5:1 and up). Also the middle of the front page punchline's gradient (3.8:1 on surface, at headline size).

tokens.name: violet-light
tokens.usage: The violet band's lightest corner, bottom right; nothing is written on it. Also the far end of the front page punchline's gradient (8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Ask Sig's tab bar and floating panels: search results, menus, pickers (--os-bar, --raised).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: The side panel and the foot of a window (--os-side, --band, --ink-3).

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Round Ask Sig's window: the gap that frames it on a desktop (--os-page, --os-stat).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Words and headlines on surface, surface-raised, bar, side and page (19:1 and up). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary words, ledes, inactive places on surface, surface-raised, bar, side and page (8:1 and up).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Labels, kickers and timestamps, in the body face, on surface, surface-raised, bar, side and page (5:1 and up).

tokens.name: text-read
tokens.usage: The words of an answer or of any block an agent signed, a little under text so the agents’ colours stand out.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: A row under the pointer, the row that is open or picked.

tokens.name: suede
tokens.usage: The Noise card's ground in signal and noise: matte grey suede, a fine grain (img/suede.svg) laid over it and a soft light from the top left. Words on it are text-2, never muted (decision, November 19).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: window and card frames, dividers. Decorative: a frame never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Borders of hairline buttons and fields.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one main action per view: electric blue, lit from the top (accent-hi), with white words and a soft glow. Never two on a screen.

tokens.name: accent-hi
tokens.usage: The top of the main action’s fill, and the main action on hover.

tokens.name: signal-2
tokens.usage: The Signal’s second blue, for a scale’s far end.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Words on accent.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Signal blue (the name stays for the code’s sake): the community and its Signal only: the live dot, scores and moves up, points, the community’s place and tab. Black words on it.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: Mint: the studies only: grades, the evidence meter, the rungs in a print, the Library’s mark.

tokens.name: safety
tokens.usage: The Safety agent: the "safety on" dot, a caution's bead in a print. As text on surface, 6.9:1.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: A Signal's move down, a worse outcome, as text on surface and surface-raised (9:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The preview's banner ground (with on-accent words, 10:1) and a mixed read. Not a brand colour.

tokens.name: agent-safety
tokens.usage: The Safety agent: first to read, last to check. Its glyph, its step in a run, its arc of the ring.

tokens.name: agent-planner
tokens.usage: The Planner: turns goals into measures.

tokens.name: agent-recommender
tokens.usage: The Recommender: finds and reads the fact sheets.

tokens.name: agent-community
tokens.usage: The community: member and forum reports.

tokens.name: agent-combination
tokens.usage: The Combination agent: overlap, or different paths.

tokens.name: agent-markers
tokens.usage: The Markers agent: blood tests pushed two ways.

tokens.name: agent-synergy
tokens.usage: The Synergy auditor: checks it all with your medicines.

tokens.name: agent-evidence
tokens.usage: The Evidence librarian: finds every study result. Its own blue in Sig’s ring; the grades it signs are mint.

tokens.name: agent-relatives
tokens.usage: The Relatives agent: evidence from close relatives.

tokens.name: agent-mechanism
tokens.usage: The Mechanism agent: how each one could work.

tokens.name: agent-builder
tokens.usage: The Stack builder: lays out options to discuss. Also My stack's mark.

tokens.name: agent-interpretation
tokens.usage: The Interpretation agent, at the ring's centre: efficacy, reasoned last. White, every colour at once.

tokens.name: op-is
tokens.usage: A print's bead: the compound acts there.

tokens.name: op-up
tokens.usage: A print's bead: raises. Told apart by hue and by the legend's words, never by hue alone.

tokens.name: op-down
tokens.usage: A print's bead: lowers.

tokens.name: op-block
tokens.usage: A print's bead: blocks.

tokens.name: op-watch
tokens.usage: A print's bead: worth a blood test.

tokens.name: op-warn
tokens.usage: A print's bead: a caution, always outermost, ringed in surface.

families.display: "Mona Sans Display", "Mona Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The front page's one headline: Mona Sans at its widest (font-stretch 125%), 800, in capitals; 34 to 64px with the window. Its second sentence takes the punchline's gradient (lime to violet to violet-light).

styles.name: section
styles.usage: A section's heading: wide, 800, in capitals; 26 to 36px with the window on the pages as built (the Join band's runs to 51px).

styles.name: page
styles.usage: A page's h1: wide, 800, in capitals; 26 to 34.5px with the window on the pages as built.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: A heading inside a page: wide, 800, in capitals; 17 to 19px on the pages as built. A card's title is h3, never this.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Your report moves the number for the next person, even if it did nothing.
styles.usage: Under a headline, in text-2, at most 50ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Behind every answer are twelve agents, each with one job, each signing what it made.
styles.usage: The site's copy.

styles.name: body-app
styles.sample: What members took and how it went.
styles.usage: The community app's copy.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card titles, a post's title (17.5px in the feed).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: A row of the side panel: a place, a menu item.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons, sentence case, verb first (14px on a small button).

styles.name: read
styles.usage: An answer's words and anything an agent signed, in text-read.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: A note under a block, a step under a commit.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: One short phrase over a heading, in sentence case, muted (Signal blue over the Signal). No rule before it, no dots in it, never in the code face (the owner's rule, November 18).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, a table's column heads, a card's head, a group's name: sentence case in the body face.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: A meta line under a heading, a caption under a figure: plain words, muted. Not for anything a reader must read to act.

styles.name: fine
styles.sample: Sig is an AI. No doses, sellers or diagnosis.
styles.usage: Small print under a box or a button: a disclaimer, a footnote.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers only, tabular figures: scores, counts, percentages and figures in tables. Words are never set in the code face (the owner's rule, November 18).

styles.name: number
styles.usage: A total on a board: live signals, reports, moves, members; the ring's count.

styles.name: number-lg
styles.usage: A Signal standing on its own, in text with the community's lime pip beside it.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: A chart's axis numbers and footnote numbers, in the code face: numbers only.

spacing.note: The window's own measures. Inside a page, padding follows the component's spec.

tokens.name: window-gap
tokens.usage: The page-coloured gap round Sig's window on a desktop (0 on a phone).

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: The padding inside a window's body in the community. On the site's pages the side padding is 40px (20px from 701 to 900px wide, 16px on a phone), the same for the page, its foot and the path line; on a phone, 16px everywhere.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Between the feed and the rail in the community.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Between cards in the rail, between a page's blocks.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a table cell (10px on narrow screens).

size.note: Fixed sizes of the window's parts.

tokens.name: side-panel
tokens.usage: The side panel's width; on a phone a drawer of min(86vw, 300px).

tokens.name: title-bar
tokens.usage: Sig's title bar on the site (52px on a phone, so its controls are 40px targets); 52px in the community, where search and your things sit in it.

tokens.name: path-line
tokens.usage: Retired (the owner's rule, November 18): no page has a path line.

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: Retired (the owner's rule, November 18): no page has a status bar; Ask Sig's window ends at its typing bar.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: A row of the side panel: one of the four places, or a menu item.

tokens.name: row-more
tokens.usage: A row of the side panel's quieter "more" list, so the panel fits a 900px-tall screen (40px in the phone drawer).

tokens.name: tab
tokens.usage: A window tab (34px in the community), sitting on the window like a file's tab in an editor.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner is square (decision, November 13): cards, plates, tables, panes, Sig's window and its bars, buttons, fields, tags, chips, tabs, rows, menus, dialogs, meters and the tags in drawings.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only dots and rings are round: pips, live dots, agent dots, a tab's dot, avatars and Sig's ring button.

shadow.note: Nothing casts a shadow but what floats over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels: search results, menus, pickers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The side panel when it slides in over the page on a phone.
